# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated: CN code missing

The ruleset requires three inputs before any calculation. One of them is missing.

| Required input | Scenario value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in factor table | "to be confirmed" (described only as "steel long product") | ❌ Missing |
| (b) Country of production | Türkiye | ✅ Listed in table |
| (c) Quantity (tonnes) | 1,000 t | ✅ Provided |

**Why I can't proceed:** The default SEE is selected by CN code and country together. Without a confirmed CN code, no single factor applies. The description "steel long product" doesn't identify one table row. It could plausibly match more than one heading, for example semi-finished products (7207) or bars and rods (7214). Choosing one or giving a range would be an estimate, which the ruleset prohibits.

## Next step

Ask the mill to confirm the exact CN code. For reference, these are the Türkiye defaults in the table:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 1.85 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 1.96 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 3.087 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, with indentations etc. | 2.31 |

Once the CN code is confirmed, the calculation is:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN code, Türkiye) × 1,000 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the confirmed code is not in the table above, a calculation still can't be made under this ruleset.
